stance_rationale: Post-shrink covariance fails the role-mandated cond <= 100 gate by 12.27x, and the package still asks downstream Optimizer to rely on a numerically weak Σ. Tail, regime, crowding, PIT, and artifact-governance checks also have unresolved hard failures rather than bounded caveats.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: CRISIS n=33 and Transition_LR n=29 are below the role prompt's bootstrap/fallback threshold; no regime-conditional Σ fallback or switch-rate audit is present.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: Not measured as HHI or L-219-style family saturation; reported STR_1715 correlation 0.7165 and RMW/HML overlap imply unresolved Quality/Value redundancy.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Σ window uses daily Ret through 2026-04-30 for signal_as_of 2026-04-30; no t-1 exclusion is demonstrated for volatility/covariance inputs.
Stress and crowding histories use final 2026-04-30 BHEQ tickers backward over 2001-2026 with NA zero-fill, creating survivorship/inception bias risk.
Risk universe inherits 5e7 liquidity while base hard constraint is 20d TV >= 2e8; no 2e8 rerun is provided.
External factor data is read from .cache/kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet with no explicit FRED/KR-internals lag verification.
KR FF5/WML factor-return PIT/backfill audit is asserted but not demonstrated; only 24 aligned monthly observations feed the 6F covariance.

critical_concerns.description: The selected post-shrink Σ has cond=1227.055, far above the cond <= 100 mandatory gate; the package's internal RF-R2 threshold of >500 silently weakens the role prompt requirement.

Shrinkage is not a true Ledoit-Wolf oracle estimate: the script hard-codes alpha=0.30 for a constant-correlation target, excludes the only cond<=100 candidate as a benchmark, and does not issue an infeasibility report.
Risk estimation and stress tests are not PIT-clean: same-day 2026-04-30 returns enter Σ, and final 2026 constituents are projected backward into historical stress windows.
Regime diagnostics fail RF-R8: CRISIS n=33 and Transition_LR n=29 have no bootstrap CI, pooled fallback, bounds shrink, or regime switch-rate reconciliation.

Tail and stress gates are understated: cvar_95_daily=4.01% breaches the 2.5% cap, while GFC and COVID MDD exceed 25%; the script only flags cumulative GFC/COVID losses, missing RF-R4 drawdown exposure.
Crowding is a hard fail, not a caveat: STR_1715 Pearson cor=0.7165 and lower-tail TDC=0.7222 exceed thresholds, HHI is absent, and BHEQ blends worsen MDD at every tested weight.

Artifact governance is incomplete: only risk_package_draft.json exists, no risk_challenge_note.md or weights.csv is present, package refs omit the actual qepm/stage_artifacts prefix, and covariance has 280 tickers versus 281 finite alpha tickers with A064400 dropped.
KR FF5/WML factor covariance uses 24 aligned monthly observations for six factors, has factor-cov cond=342.64, and provides no C11/C12 backfill or usable-date proof.
The 5e7 liquidity override remains unresolved against the base 2e8 hard constraint, so the risk universe may understate capacity and tail liquidity risk.

supporting_arguments: covariance.parquet is symmetric and positive definite: min_eig=6.575064e-05, no negative eigenvalues.
alpha_scores.parquet is genuinely time-series: 220 dates, 72063 rows, no duplicate Date-Ticker pairs.
Factor coverage R2 mean=0.422 and median=0.409 pass the 30% coverage expectation, but this does not rescue the cond and PIT failures.
unresolved_disputes: Whether any Σ with off-diagonal structure can satisfy cond <= 100 without diagonal-only collapse.
Whether risk should proceed without a final risk_package.json and risk_challenge_note.md.
Whether the optimizer universe is 281 alpha names or 280 covariance names.
Whether weights.csv schedule validation is out-of-scope or simply missing.
Whether 5e7 liquidity can override the base 2e8 mandate for risk estimation.
weakest_assumption: A fixed-alpha 0.30 constant-correlation shrinkage covariance with cond=1227 can be treated as an optimizer-ready post-shrink Σ because it is PSD.
rebuttal_required: Produce a post-shrink Σ with cond <= 100 or file an explicit infeasibility report before optimizer handoff.
Rerun Σ with t-1 cutoff relative to signal_as_of and document the exact usable-date boundary.
Rebuild stress and crowding tests using PIT-eligible historical universes, not the final 2026 ticker set.
Add CRISIS/Transition bootstrap CIs or pooled fallback with bounds shrink.
Report final-portfolio CVaR/CDaR after weights, plus HHI and turnover schedule from weights.csv.
Create risk_challenge_note.md and reconcile alpha 281-name vector against 280-name covariance.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The risk package is admirably honest about some failures, but it converts hard gates into downstream caveats; AX-008 is not met because independent verification, final packaging, weights schedule, and risk challenge response are incomplete.

risk_specific_questions: If cond<=100 is mandatory, why is cond=1227 accepted instead of shrinkage escalation or infeasibility reporting?
What is the exact t-1 risk data cutoff for a 2026-04-30 signal, and why does the covariance window include 2026-04-30 returns?
How will Optimizer handle the 281 alpha names versus 280 covariance names without silent ticker deletion?
Is lower-tail TDC 0.7222 measured on returns time series or cross-sectional holdings overlap, and where is HHI versus PG2 active book?
